steps.text: Open the next request in the refunds inbox
steps.detail: Screen sorted newest first; narration says oldest first
steps.evidence: Seen: inbox sorted newest first and the newest request opened. Heard: “I always take the oldest one first.” These disagree, so the handling order needs confirming.

steps.text: Look up the order by its number
steps.detail: Order number from the email, typed into Orders search
steps.evidence: Seen: ORD-10421 typed into the order search and Search clicked.

steps.text: Check it was bought within the last 30 days
steps.detail: Older than 30 days → store credit only
steps.evidence: Heard while pointing at the purchase date. The 30-day limit isn't shown on screen.
steps.quote: If it's more than thirty days old we can only do store credit.

steps.text: Check the refund isn't more than the order total
steps.detail: Refund amount compared with order total
steps.evidence: Cursor moved between Order total and Refund amount.
steps.quote: Make sure they're not asking for more than they paid.

steps.evidence: Heard while opening the Approver list; the £500 threshold isn't shown on screen.
steps.quote: Anything over five hundred pounds I send to my manager first, before I touch the payment.

steps.detail: Refund goes back to the original card
steps.evidence: Seen: Issue refund clicked; confirmation banner shown.
Seen: “Refund confirmed” template chosen and the email sent.
